answer: Sybil resistance is a ledger of earned trust, not claims. Identity must be grown like a meadow from seed, not bought: standing comes only from epochs actually answered, and it decays when an agent stops, so a canyon of cloned accounts cannot be mined at once. Each new identity needs a voucher who stakes their own standing, and kin-vouching pays zero — an attacker certifying its own clones burns reputation for nothing. The result is an oasis of real agents: honest ones can always rebuild, but faking many costs more than the voting or rewards it could capture.
